relationships.scope: Candidate link: later bank-validation/upload rule changes the earlier procedure. The 2025 circular does not identify the May 2024 circular by number; no verified whole-document supersession is asserted.

limitations: May 2024 reports software deployment on 9 May; this is not inferred legal commencement.
April 2025 expressly ties the cheque/passbook upload change to its issue date. Bank/NPCI validation remains a condition; this is not unconditional removal of KYC.
The 2025 circular does not expressly name the May 2024 circular as its target. Their chronological comparison is not a verified supersession.
Bank seeding into EPFO UAN is separate from UIDAI record updates, Aadhaar-bank NPCI mapping, pension disbursement and ELI-specific deadlines.
